meta.title: GitHub
meta.description: GitHub inside DeepSeek Harness. The agent gets the official GitHub MCP server's full mcp__github__* tool set — repositories, issues, pull requests, reviews, checks, code search and notifications, readable and writable — and the right sidebar gains a GitHub tab that follows this Session's workspace repository and lists its issues, pull requests and notifications, with a detail view and a comment box. Write tools (create, update, merge, comment) ask for your approval before they run. The tab accepts a pasted personal access token and can also copy the OAuth token the GitHub CLI already holds into the Harness credential store in one step; a GITHUB_TOKEN line in $DSH_HOME/.env works the same way. Requests carry your token straight to GitHub with no proxy in between. Only github.com is supported. Disabling the plugin removes the tools and the tab; the stored token stays where it is.
